description: Reference output of the AiM SmartyCam parser (NS-55: public/js/import/smartycam.js, then channels.js) over the committed files in contracts/logic/smartycam/. A port must reproduce lap times to the millisecond, lap windows and coordinates to 1e-9 and every per-lap channel array element for element. Every time here except a lap's timeMs is VIDEO time (frame / fps). Car channel series are summarized (count, first, last, every 100th). Regenerate with `npm run contracts:logic`; never hand-edit.

files.note: Counter from 0 through four steps: the out-lap is dropped and three laps follow. The second lap loses a third of its frames for 12 s, so it is ~4 s shorter in video time than its 47.12 s. The x1e7 latitude/longitude trail the ECEF fix; the car fields read NO_VALUE for 4 s.

Starts with the counter at 3 and resets it to 0 at 80 s (a second logger run in one file): two laps. The gear field holds values past 8, so that channel is dropped. No XML block: the date and time come from the mvhd creation time, in UTC.
